t: This is Madame Tussauds, the wax museum in London. It was founded in 1835 by the French wax sculptor Marie Tussaud, and it still carries her name. She was an artist known for her wax sculptures, and this is the museum she built in London. One of its early main attractions was the Chamber of Horrors, which appeared in advertising in 1843. Marie Tussaud lived from 1761 to 1850, so she saw the museum open when she was already in her seventies.
